candidates.title: GoShuin: Goshuin Map & Journal for iPhone
candidates.why: Book-like editorial landing: Georgia serif title page, hairline bronze rules, underlined text links instead of filled buttons; paper #f8f3e7 with slate ink, airy, motion 1. The calm, unhyped register the audience trusts.
candidates.leave: Pixel-dithered Japanese pattern art; scale the 129px display down for long RU/ES words.

candidates.title: Half the Sky
candidates.why: Editorial and landing in a warm stone-grey palette; centred one-row nav that stays out of the way; a hairline-ruled 4-up grid as the base for a calm card system; motion 1.
candidates.leave: Tracked-out caps everywhere and #66645c on #dddcd7 ink, which fails the 7:1 floor.

candidates.title: The Quaker School at Horsham
candidates.why: Soft serif display with its own sans sibling for body text at 18.6px; chapter-like 220–444px section gaps; short plain-label nav; ivory and near-black. Bold pick.
candidates.leave: Video hero and 226px display; motion level 2 is over budget. Newsreader (the open alternative) lacks Cyrillic.

candidates.title: Stash
candidates.why: Directory with real editorial structure: ruled section headers, bracketed pagers, mono meta lines, horizontal article cards. Covers nav, card-system and buttons; motion 1.
candidates.leave: Giant slab wordmark, #8a8a8a deks below 4.5:1, highlighter yellow; Space Mono lacks Cyrillic.

candidates.title: Farm Minerals
candidates.why: Bone/olive duotone with one regular-weight grotesk; outlined CTA with dot markers; three-item quiet nav. Warmth without default cream.
candidates.leave: 3D product render hero, uppercase Arial body, GSAP ScrollTrigger reveals; motion level 2 is over budget.

combinations.label: A
combinations.character: GoShuin as it is: serif title page, paper and slate with bronze rules, text-link CTAs. The calmest and closest to the brief.

combinations.label: B
combinations.character: Serif/sans pairing over a warm stone ground with ruled horizontal cards and mono meta: editorial essays with a precise, technical index.

combinations.label: C
combinations.character: GoShuin's book-like structure with Quaker's short plain-label top nav. The most restrained top bar.
